summary: Status (closed for the season from August 1, 2026 for campground and restroom improvements; the closure names Nutbush Area 1 (North) and Areas 3&4 (South), i.e. all three Nutbush areas) and season (Area 3 year-round with 24-hour gate access; Area 1 from March 23, Area 4 from May 18) re-read on the park's pages and stand, as do fees ($30 / +$10 electric). Added 50-amp electric (Area 3 is 30) with water at the site, 77 bookable sites with five pull-throughs, shower houses, 6-month window and the booking site's holiday minimum (waived within 14 days, not the agency row's 7). Not stated: sewer, a dump station at this campground, walk-up sites, max stay, same-day cutoff time, a reopening date. Note kept (AWH).
